description: This Java class defines the HiveMqtt5PublisherActor, an Akka actor responsible for publishing MQTT 5 messages using the HiveMQ client. It maps external messages to MQTT publish messages, handles message payload encoding, and manages message headers and properties.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5PublisherActor
classes.description: An actor class for publishing MQTT 5 messages using HiveMQ client, specializing in mapping external messages to MQTT publish messages, handling payload encoding, and setting message properties.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Akka Props configuration for instantiating HiveMqtt5PublisherActor instances with required parameters.

methods.name: mapExternalMessageToMqttMessage
methods.description: Maps an ExternalMessage to an Mqtt5Publish message, encoding payloads appropriately and setting headers and properties.

methods.name: getTopic
methods.description: Returns the topic string from the MQTT message.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Returns an optional containing the message payload; currently always empty.
